title: Multi-Level Optimal Transport for Universal Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation on Language Models
tldr_zh: 双层 OT（token 级排序截断 + 序列级 Sinkhorn）对齐不同词表 logit，跨 tokenizer 蒸馏优于 ULD
tldr_en: Dual-level OT (token-level ranking/truncation + sequence-level Sinkhorn) aligns logits across tokenizers, outperforming ULD in CTKD
